# 1 Enoch Chapter 72 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn-astr (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**72:1** The-book of-the-courses of-the-luminaries of-the-heaven, the-relations of-each, according-to their-classes, their-dominion and-their-seasons, according-to their-names and-places-of-origin, and-according-to their-months, which Uriel, the-holy angel who-was with-me, who-is their-guide, showed me; and-he-showed me all their-laws exactly as-they-are, and-how it-is with-regard-to all the-years of-the-world and-unto eternity, till the-new creation is-accomplished which-dureth till eternity.

**72:2** And-this is-the-first law of-the-luminaries: the-luminary the-Sun has-its-rising in-the-eastern portals of-the-heaven, and-its-setting in-the-western portals of-the-heaven.

**72:3** And-I-saw six portals in-which the-sun rises, and-six portals in-which the-sun sets, and-the-moon rises and-sets in-these-portals, and-the-leaders of-the-stars and-those-whom-they-lead: six in-the-east and-six in-the-west, and-all following each-other in-accurately corresponding order; also-many windows to-the-right and-left of-these-portals.

**72:4** And-first there-goes-forth the-great luminary, named the-Sun, and-his circuit is-as the-circuit of-the-heaven, and-he-proceeds into-the-west for-180 days and-sets in-the-west.

**72:5** And-in-those days the-day becomes longer and-the-night becomes shorter, so-that the-day is-longer-by-a-tenth than the-night.

**72:6** And-the-day is-exactly ten parts and-the-night is-eight parts.

**72:7** And-the-sun rises from-that portal, the-third one, proceeds and-sets in-the-third portal in-the-west, and-goes-forth for-thirty-one days and-sets in-the-second portal.

**72:8** And-in-those days the-night becomes longer and-the-day becomes shorter, until-the-thirtieth morning is-reached, when-the-day is-exactly ten parts and-the-night is-eight parts.

**72:9** And-at-the-setting of-the-sun the-night-ruler begins his-course. And-in-those days the-night becomes longer and-the-day becomes shorter.

**72:10** And-in-those days the-night is-exactly nine parts and-the-day is-nine parts, and-the-night is-equal to-the-day.

**72:11** And-the-night is-exactly nine parts and-the-day is-nine parts.

**72:12** And-in-those days the-sun rises from-that portal and-sets in-the-west, and-returns to-the-east, and-rises in-the-fourth portal for-thirty-one mornings, and-sets in-the-west of-the-heaven.

**72:13** In-those days the-day becomes longer day-by-day and-the-night shorter night-by-night until-the-thirtieth morning.

**72:14** In-those days the-day becomes ten parts and-the-night eight parts.

**72:15** And-the-sun rises from-that portal and-sets in-the-fifth portal in-the-west for-thirty days, and-rises in-the-fifth portal and-sets in-the-fifth portal in-the-west.

**72:16** In-those days the-day becomes longer and-the-night shorter until-the-day is-eleven parts and-the-night is-seven parts.

**72:17** And-the-sun returns to-the-east and-enters the-sixth portal and-rises and-sets in-the-sixth portal for-thirty-one days by-reason of-its-sign.

**72:18** In-those days the-day becomes longer than-the-night, and-the-day becomes double the-night, and-the-day becomes twelve parts and-the-night becomes six parts.

**72:19** And-the-sun rises up so-that the-day is-shortened and-the-night is-lengthened, and-the-sun returns to-the-east and-enters the-sixth portal and-rises and-sets in-the-sixth portal for-thirty days.

**72:20** And-in-those days the-day grows shorter and-the-night grows longer, and-in-thirty days the-day is-ten parts and-the-night is-eight parts.

**72:21** And-the-sun goes-forth from-the-sixth portal and-sets in-the-west, and-proceeds to-the-east and-rises in-the-fifth portal for-thirty days, and-sets in-the-west again.

**72:22** In-those days the-day becomes eleven parts and-the-night seven parts.

**72:23** And-the-sun goes-forth from-the-fifth portal and-sets in-the-fifth portal in-the-west, and-rises in-the-fourth portal for-thirty-one days by-reason of-its-sign, and-sets in-the-west.

**72:24** In-those days the-day becomes equal to-the-night, and-they-are equal, and-the-night becomes nine parts and-the-day nine parts.

**72:25** And-the-sun rises from-the-fourth portal and-sets in-the-fourth portal, and-returns to-the-east and-rises in-the-third portal for-thirty-one mornings, and-sets in-the-west of-the-heaven.

**72:26** In-those days the-night becomes longer than-the-day, and-the-night becomes double the-day, and-the-night becomes ten parts and-the-day becomes eight parts.

**72:27** And-the-sun rises from-that third portal and-sets in-the-third portal in-the-west, and-returns to-the-east and-rises for-thirty mornings in-the-second portal of-the-east, and-sets in-the-second portal of-the-heaven in-the-west.

**72:28** And-in-those days the-night becomes eleven parts and-the-day seven parts.

**72:29** And-the-sun returns to-the-east on-that day, and-enters the-first portal, and-sets for-thirty-one mornings in-the-west in-the-first portal of-the-heaven.

**72:30** And-in-those days the-night becomes longer and-reaches double the-day; and-the-night becomes twelve parts and-the-day six parts.

**72:31** And-the-sun has-traversed the-divisions of-his-course and-turns-again on-those divisions of-his-course, and-enters that portal thirty mornings and-sets also in-the-west opposite-to it.

**72:32** And-in-that night the-night decreases in-length by-a-ninth part, and-the-night is-eleven parts and-the-day seven parts.

**72:33** And-the-sun returns and-enters the-second portal in-the-east, and-returns on-these divisions of-his-course for-thirty mornings, rising and-setting.

**72:34** And-in-those days the-night decreases in-length, and-the-night is-nine parts and-the-day nine parts, and-the-night is-equal to-the-day.

**72:35** And-the-year is-exactly as-to-its-days three-hundred and-sixty-four days.

**72:36** And-the-length of-the-day and-of-the-night, and-the-shortness of-the-day and-of-the-night are-different because-of the-journey of-the-sun these-differences come-about.

**72:37** So-it-comes-about that its-journey becomes daily longer, and-its-journey nightly shorter, by-reason of-the-sun and-by-reason of-its-portals.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words \[thus\] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text. The Astronomical Book presents a 364-day solar calendar of great significance for Second Temple sectarian groups (cf. Qumran). 4QEn-astr preserves Aramaic fragments of this section.*
